lines.trans: We spend a lot of time together. Get used to it.
Maybe I should bring my mom here, then?
I want to spend a lot of time with them, too.
It is fine. You will get along.
Kostya, tell the story about the strawberry mojito.
And the one about the bald guy.
That never happened.
For some reason, I am not surprised.
Anyway, you stay a while. We should probably get going.

Guys, what is going on?

You're not at work right now. You stay; we're leaving.
Kostya, where are you going?
Why didn't you tell me they would be here?

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: You will be asking for forgiveness.

examples.text: Я и сама хорошо проведу время.
examples.trans: I'll have a good time on my own.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

examples.text: А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Так, мы идём к слепым. А ты иди домой и делай уроки.
examples.trans: Right, we're going to the blind people. And you go home and do your homework.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
used with не before the verb, or alone

examples.text: Я никогда не был на море.
examples.trans: I've never been to the sea.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.

examples.text: Хочешь понравиться женщине? Подружись с её ребёнком.
examples.trans: Want a woman to like you? Make friends with her child.
It is fine. You will get along.
It's time for us to go.
All right, Arkashenka. We'll be off, it's time.
Why are we going so slowly?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!
And now for some reason he is silent.

examples.text: А сейчас он почему-то просто молчит.
examples.trans: And now for some reason he is simply silent.

examples.text: Только почему-то рыба здесь совсем не клюёт.
examples.trans: Only for some reason the fish do not bite here at all.

проводить.gloss: to see off, to see out

meanings.en: to see someone out, to see off
meanings.note: accompany someone to the door or the station
a different, imperfective verb проводить means 'to conduct, to spend (time)'

examples.text: Держи свои духи. Давай я тебя провожу. Пока!
examples.trans: Here is your perfume. Let me walk you out. Bye!

meanings.note: informal: a group of young men; ребята! = guys!

examples.trans: The boys will have a word with you.

examples.text: Тогда ребята с тобой поработают. До свидания, Аркадий Борисович.
examples.trans: Then the boys will have a little word with you. Goodbye, Arkady Borisovich.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.trans: Share it all equally with everyone, understand?

meanings.note: once; что скажешь? = what do you say?

examples.trans: Tell us, when will your programme be out?

meanings.note: 'что я за мэр такой' = what kind of mayor am I

examples.text: Мы же здесь выросли. И о людях тоже надо думать.
examples.trans: After all, we grew up here. And you have to think about people too.
There's someone here to see you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, I'm sorry, there's a man here to see you.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.
They want to build a shopping centre there.

examples.text: Привет! Смотри, что у меня есть.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: And this is for you. A toy car!
This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Это Паша, мой заместитель. Это Ваня, друг моего детства.
examples.trans: This is Pasha, my deputy. This is Vanya, my childhood friend.

examples.text: Мы с Пашей вместе уже месяц.
examples.trans: Pasha and I have been together for a month now.

meanings.en: to get used to, grow accustomed to

examples.trans: Get used to your new life.
A person quickly gets used to good things.

examples.text: Привыкай к своей новой скромной жизни.
examples.trans: Get used to your new modest life.
Dad, did you bring any gum?

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

examples.text: Я тебе тогда сказал: ты меня ещё поцелуешь.
examples.trans: I told you back then: you'll kiss me one day.
The white one? Give me the keys.

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

meanings.note: from a trip, by car, train or plane

examples.trans: Dad, did you bring any gum?

meanings.note: ironic: Сталину расскажите = tell that to Stalin

examples.text: Этого не может быть. Это наша история.
examples.trans: That can't be. It's our history.

meanings.note: takes the accusative; everyday synonym of о

examples.trans: He says nasty things about me.

examples.text: Как интересно! А в Москве ты про меня гадости рассказываешь.
examples.trans: How interesting! And in Moscow you go around saying nasty things about me.

meanings.note: hesitation, at the start of a sentence

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.
examples.trans: Well, four-eyes? See, there's nothing left.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.
A bald man sat at the table.

examples.text: Видишь того лысого мужчину за столиком?
examples.trans: Do you see that bald man at the table?
I grew up in a communal flat.
Hello! How was it in Hungary?
This is a shared bathroom, Vanya!

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.

посидеть.gloss: to sit for a while; to stay (with someone)

meanings.note: Посиди с ним = stay with him.

examples.trans: Stay with Vika for a while.
Let's sit in a café for a bit.

examples.text: Слушай, я уеду на полтора часа. Ты с Викой посиди, понял?
examples.trans: Listen, I'm going out for an hour and a half. You stay with Vika, got it?
Well, probably somewhere in the archive.
He has probably already come home.

examples.text: Наверное, что-то серьёзное у вас. Девочка уже две недели лежит в областной клинике!
examples.trans: It must be something serious for you. The girl has been lying in the regional clinic for two weeks already!
Can I go and have a look?

examples.text: Если проблема только в этом, то да.
examples.trans: If that's the only problem, then yes.

examples.text: А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: Otherwise we were already starting to worry.
The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.
The doctor forbade him to drink.

examples.text: Аникеев же запретил! Нам нельзя пить.
examples.trans: But Anikeev forbade it! We mustn't drink.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
Остаётся у нас = stays with us.

examples.trans: And the advance stays with us.

веселиться.gloss: to have fun, to enjoy oneself

meanings.en: to have fun, to enjoy oneself, to make merry

examples.text: Ты уже без меня начал веселиться?
examples.trans: Have you already started having fun without me?
You will have fun, sing, and dance.
Hi, Arkady Borisovich. What are you doing?

examples.text: Конечно, помогу. Кто у вас сейчас начальник?
examples.trans: Of course I'll help. Who's your boss now?

meanings.en: to leave, to go away (on foot)

meanings.note: For movement; где is for location.

examples.trans: Wait, where are you two going?

meanings.note: Borrowed word; it never changes its ending.

указывать.gloss: to tell (someone what to do); to point

meanings.en: to tell (someone what to do); to point
meanings.note: With мне, тебе and so on it means bossing someone about.

examples.trans: Don't tell me what to do!
You don't get to tell me what to do.

examples.text: Ты будешь приятно удивлён этим супом!
examples.trans: You will be pleasantly surprised by this soup!
